text:
jamal: heads up — apiserver 5xx spike in eu-west1 starting ~13:08 UTC, connections piling up, users seeing 504s
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-345 (severity 2)
ingrid: seeing apiserver logs: `http2: stream closed` and `read tcp 10.20.30.40:6443->...: connection reset by peer`
alex: controller-manager is entering backoff for replicationcontrollers: `couldn't create pod: etcdserver: leader changed`
maria: and kube-scheduler reports pods stuck Pending in gpu pools — looks like node-provisioner is throttled
jamal: I pulled `kubectl get --raw '/metrics'` and apiserver `request_latencies_seconds_bucket` skewed; also node fd usage at 98% on api-proxy
ingrid: also check etcd disk stalls: iostat shows avgqu-sz 24 and await 150ms on /dev/nvme1n1
alex: that matches the SSD iops saturation on the new cheaper instance type we rolled last night (gp3-low-iops)
maria: can we temp failover controlplane to us-west? traffic is region-routed by gw policy
jamal: plan: 1) scale etcd to 5 -> gotta schedule maintenance 2) bump apiserver --max-requests-inflight=300 -> but that just delays 3) replace low-iops nvme with high-iops for etcd nodes 4) throttle controller-manager requeues
ingrid: doing quick mitigation: cordoning noncritical GPU nodes to reduce provisioning churn
alex: I'm on creating a hotfix to pin provisioning to dedicated pool to avoid spiky node creation
maria: cost note: switching to i3en or higher iops will add ~$1.2k/mo per AZ; tradeoff w/ SLOs
jamal: can someone run `kubectl describe pod kube-apiserver -n kube-system` on leader and paste the recent events?
ingrid: pasted:
```
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age    From               Message
  ----    ------     ----   ----               -------
  Warning ReadTimedOut 2m kubelet    Readiness probe failed: Get "https://127.0.0.1:6443/healthz": net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```
alex: I'm raising a ticket with infra to provision gp3-high-iops in eu-west1
sre-bot: escalation: paging on-call (ingrid) @channel :rotating_light:
maria: on-call notified, will start rolling etcd leader eviction to balance IO
jamal: add an override: set apiserver eviction to prefer node-health to avoid thundering provisioning
ingrid: temporary mitigation applied, apiserver 5xx down to normal levels 13:22 UTC
alex: followups: audit the recent instance type change in provider-configs, add monitoring alert on avgqu-sz>10
maria: also add cost/benefit doc to runbook, +1 to keep gp3-high for etcd
jamal: thanks — I'll open a follow-up doc and reassign action items
sre-bot: incident resolved (severity deescalated to S0) 13:35 UTC
